description: This Rust source file defines the SDVClient struct and its associated asynchronous methods for interacting with a data broker service, including retrieving metadata, datapoints, setting datapoints, subscribing to updates, and updating datapoints.

classes.name: SDVClient
classes.description: A client for interacting with the data broker service, providing methods for metadata retrieval, datapoint management, and subscriptions.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Creates a new instance of SDVClient with the specified URI.

methods.name: get_metadata
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves metadata for given paths; returns a list of Metadata objects.

methods.name: get_datapoints
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves datapoints for specified paths; returns a HashMap of datapoints.

methods.name: set_datapoints
methods.description: Asynchronously sets multiple datapoints; returns a SetDatapointsReply.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes to updates based on a query string; returns a stream of SubscribeReply messages.

methods.name: update_datapoints
methods.description: Updates datapoints with a HashMap of datapoints; returns an UpdateDatapointsReply.
